reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tire shop

reviews.author: Kimberly Allen
reviews.text: We had a tire rapidly leaking air on our way to a baseball tournament in Pigeon Forge. Thank goodness, we happened to be close to Forest City Tire. They took our van right back and patched it up for us so we could get back on the road. They were super friendly and helpful - we are so grateful and appreciate such excellent customer service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kevin Strother
reviews.text: I had to visit this tire place last minute and they came through clutch! I ran over on of the biggest screws I had ever seen (pictures below). The men here were able to get me in and out in under an hour so I can be home for my kiddos to get off the bus! Definitely, visit here and they also have great prices on used tires!

reviews.author: Wanda Knapp
reviews.text: We were on vacation in the Forest City, NC area when we found a screw in our tire. We went to Forest City Tire to see if they had time to fix it and they immediately took our truck in and fixed the tire in less than half an hour at a very reasonable price. They treated us great and we were thrilled with the amazing service!

reviews.author: Deborah Burgin
reviews.text: My father is dead now, but he always trusted these folks, and I've had great experiences with them, as well. I like dealing with trustworthy people. Unlike Broadway Tire, Forest City Tire is actually located on Broadway!

reviews.author: Jay Turney
reviews.text: These guys are awesome, they got me in last minute and are super quick along with great prices and were great talking to in general. Couldn't have asked for better service .

reviews.author: Tara M
reviews.text: They do a great job quickly. I love quick efficient transactions. Honest men with good prices. I had tires put on and a hub fixed. We will be taking our business there from now on!

reviews.author: Tristan V.
reviews.text: These guys were fast, friendly and efficient especially when I WAS in a pinch and needed something done in a very last second pinch. Would recommend!

reviews.author: LORI BURNETT
reviews.text: Had a flat on the interstate. Not being from NC wasn't sure where to go. Had to depend on Google. Happy to say I was in and out in less than 10 minutes. Very reasonable price and they didn't try to upsell. They took care of my problem and had me on my way!! Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Erik Tardio
reviews.text: Fixed my problem. The cowan did to my car great service. One two three in and out even told me how to go fix my other problems though. I'll be going back to them. Plenty of times. Plenty of times. Thank you all

reviews.author: Gilbert Isa
reviews.text: The truck in the photo is the vehicle with 4 brand new Copper tires I purchased at Forest City Tire. You can't get better service anywhere else.

reviews.author: Daniel Dolinger
reviews.text: Called on the phone Quoted fifty dollars to change four tires Mounted. and balance that I had bought Elsewhere. Set my wife up they informed her. It would be a 140 not 50.

reviews.author: Sven bell
reviews.text: They will lie to you even after being a faithful customer! Be careful, told wife she needed brakes so I buy brakes and rotors and get home and take wheels off 200 dollars for nothing. Half the pad still left. Should have known to check but got tires 10 times from them. Never again

reviews.author: miss Miss
reviews.text: Despite purchasing a new set of tires little over a month ago, I encountered an unfortunate situation wherein one of my tires suffered from sudden deflation due to damages inflicted by perilous conditions on the road which is not covered in its warranty. Nevertheless, thanks to the commendable service provided by Forest city tire staff who exceeded expectations to rectify this predicament.

reviews.author: Arnold Melton
reviews.text: Staff is very knowledgeable and customer friendly. Their prices are better than most and their work is fast and dependable. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Bobby Allen
reviews.text: Guys were hustling to take care of customers. They were able to work me in after a short wait. They've earned my business for next time.

reviews.author: Amber Hargett
reviews.text: They do an awesome job. I needed work done due to someone pulling out in front of me and they did it in record time. Awesome guys !!!

reviews.author: Robert E Hill
reviews.text: Brandon and Shannon Smith are the best at what they do, you can tell they strive to do high quality work that they stand by and maintain a really good customer service.

reviews.author: Deborah Camacho
reviews.text: These guys are the best! They are always kind, helpful and will tell you the truth about your vehicle.

reviews.author: David Swain
reviews.text: Awesome guys. Quick service. A regular customer of Forest City Tire was in the store when I was there for an Inspection. He commented that he's been doing business there for years and they are great to work with.

reviews.author: Don Murphy
reviews.text: Went there for an alignment. Had an appointment and was done in 30 minutes. Staff was friendly. Would recommend.

reviews.author: JULI KEMP
reviews.text: The gentleman that work here don't make me feel less than because I am a woman! They are always fast and friendly!

reviews.author: Harold Guffey
reviews.text: They're not NASCAR fast, but I was in and out with four tires and balance in less than 45 minutes. Outstanding service.

reviews.author: Charles Morehead
reviews.text: Best tire prices in town. Great customer service just ask for Brandon he will take care of you and your car. Tell him Spencer sent you.

reviews.author: Joyce Jarrell
reviews.text: The staff at Forest City Tire are the best! Always pleasant and they get you in and out in a timely manner. I wouldn't go anywhere else for tires or general maintenance on my car.

reviews.author: Kala Smith
reviews.text: Best tire place in the county!!! They always take such good care of me and I never have to worry about my car! Great prices and great workers!!

reviews.author: Zach Kopkin
reviews.text: Family has been going here for years and we've always found them to be trustworthy, friendly, and affordable. I'm a committed Forest City Tire customer!

reviews.author: Jeff Hill
reviews.text: What a good experience this visit to buy tires was. Good friendly service and good work at a competitive price. I will definitely come here again.

reviews.author: 55caytre1
reviews.text: Most honest tire and brake shop I've ever done business with. And they do great work. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Irving Ramirez
reviews.text: We had a object in the tire and another big tire company told us that it couldn't be fixed. Took it to Forest City tire and they fixed it. What a blessing

reviews.author: Mike L
reviews.text: We've been getting our tires and our vehicles serviced here for years. Brandon and his team are excellent!

reviews.author: Timmy Spence
reviews.text: I walked in the door, someone ran up to the front desk to see what I needed done, went right to work on it!
